note: Which effects a counter's unit sets off, by the kind its face carries (and, where one type differs from its kind, by the id of its picture: `art`). fire: how its fire is shown (gun: a flash, a hanging puff and a shell's streak; small: a run of tracers; lob: a thump of smoke and a round that arrives from above; none: it does not fire). armour: a round arriving on it strikes sparks (true) or throws up dirt beside it (false). dust: what it raises when it moves (tracked, wheeled, none). kill: how it ends (burn: a fireball, then a burning wreck under a column of smoke; blast: a burst of high explosive and smoke that hangs a few seconds). Kinds: the roster's (content/units/v1.units.yaml) and the reference ruleset's unit ids (its faces carry the id as their kind).
